messages:
alex: heads up: saw a class of client reconnects at 10:05 UTC after a quota burst. looks like our sticky-route lease got evicted mid-stream and clients retried, causing duplicate billing for the same logical session.
sam: ugh. can you paste the logs or the session ids?
alex: here's the minimal repro trace — small redacted snippet:
```
2026-03-10T10:05:12Z session=svc-42 lease=sticky-7 evict_reason=quota_spike route=eu-west-1->pool-b
2026-03-10T10:05:12Z session=svc-42 conn=ws-9 close_code=1006 reason="evicted:route_reassign"
2026-03-10T10:05:12Z session=svc-42 retry=1 billing_token=tok_abc123 duplicate_check=miss
```
alex: note duplicate_check=miss is when we failed to detect the in-flight token due to route change metadata not being copied.
priya: so the billing pipeline uses connection metadata to dedupe? if route swap loses the orig route id then dedupe fails?
jordan: yeah, current dedupe key is (session_id, route_id, token). if route_id flips during eviction we fall back to weaker key and duplicate slips.
maria: are we sure eviction is the root cause and not a client-side aggressive backoff?
alex: timeline aligns: eviction+immediate reconnect from same client IP, but websocket close reason is our proxy sending eviction. client backoff is normal.
sam: can we add a migration step to copy the previous route_id into the reconnect token? do we persist lease owner info to kvcache?
priya: the sticky lease is ephemeral in edge memory and not persisted across pool shuffles. We also do on-the-fly route assignment for load smoothing.
jordan: proposal: include an "orig_route_id" field in the resume token for N minutes after eviction, and teach billing/dedupe to consider orig_route_id as fallback. low-risk and backwards-compatible.
maria: ops: will that cause any privacy or exposure concerns?
ops-bot: FYI: billing teams need to be looped. tagging @billing-engineering.
sam: console UX: we should surface an "Evicted and reassigned" tag in the request timeline and in the route chart so SREs can correlate spikes to quota reassigns. right now the dashboard just shows reconnects.
alex: +1. current dashboard only shows "disconnects" which is noisy. adding an explicit telemetry event from proxy: `eviction.reason=quota_spike` would help.
priya: also suggest a rollout flag for graceful-evict: instead of immediate eviction, mark sessions as "draining" and let existing streams finish within a small window (50-200ms) unless under hard OOM. reduces double-join.
jordan: tradeoff is capacity reclaim latency. for quota enforcement bursts we want to free slots asap. maybe adaptive drain: if session is actively streaming long-polling, give short grace; if idle, evict immediately.
maria: can we add a metric to measure dedupe misses that correlate with `eviction.*` events? then we can validate mitigation.
alex: I'll add a lightweight trace event from proxy and edge: `edge.eviction.v1 {session, orig_route, new_route, reason, timestamp}`. that'll be indexed by console.
sam: for the console, we need a new annotation in request timeline: red=evicted, yellow=drained, tooltip explains "evicted due to quota spike -> may cause reconnects and duplicate billing". put it on the per-route chart and the per-tenant timeline.
priya: implementation plan: 1) edge: include orig_route in resume token & emit eviction event (canary 10%). 2) billing: accept orig_route as dedupe fallback. 3) console: add eviction annotation + metrics panel. 4) experiments: enable graceful-evict for streaming routes by tag.
maria: timeline?
jordan: edge PR + canary end of sprint. billing patch low-risk but needs QA. console patch can be smaller — just rendering new telemetry. overall 2 weeks-ish.
alex: temporary hotfix: add server-side dedupe window extended by 1s for reconnections that immediately follow eviction events. cheap and helps short bursts.
sam: fine as short-term. make sure we add a kill switch in console in case it hides other issues.
priya: will add feature flag `streaming.eviction_grace.v1` and a tracing flag `edge.emit_eviction_v1`.
maria: docs: update runbook for "streaming double-billing" and include steps to query eviction events.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-6420 to track edge/billing/console work and linked this thread.
alex: thanks everyone. follow-ups: I'll paste the PR links and the sample query for dedupe misses once I open the ticket. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — will notify billing when INF-6420 is ready for review. :thinking:
